items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not speak. The interviewer mentions Billy Eckstein in a list of musicians with 'footage underneath him' (Fletcher Henderson, Jay McShann, Billy Eckstein, Cab Calloway) to describe Dizzy Gillespie's background.

ctx.x: Cab, well, Cab mostly was an entertainer. And he studied music. I think he studied saxophone with Walter, Foots and some of them, but I guess a man the caliber that Cab was, I mean, couldn't devote too much time to studying music at that part of the game, you know, he was a big top man now you know, what's he going to study saxophone for. He studied it enough you know, and that stage of the game you know I guess he would have been able to be, if he continued, a good saxophone player.
In the way that Billy Eckstein was a decent trumpet player, trombone player.
